title: a name inherited through a supertype's own forward supertype
note: FIXED 2026-09-03 (I4). `Car :> Base :> Grand` and `Grand` owns `W`, but `Base :> Grand` is itself a forward reference — so the inheritance graph is only complete after that binds. `parseModel` binds the specialization family to a fixpoint BEFORE deciding typings, and re-decides any reference whose scope chain gained a general, which is what makes `w1` reach `P::Grand::W`.
